title: myosotis decumbens subsp. variabilis
intro: Myosotis decumbens subsp. variabilis, commonly known as creeping forget-me-not, is a plant species within the borage family (Boraginaceae) that is native to the southwestern regions of Western Australia. The health benefits of creeping forget-me-not include its potential to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential remedy for skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of Myosotis decumbens subsp. variabilis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
